lines.trans: The pasta is very tasty today, Lyova, come eat.
No, thank you very much, I have no appetite today.
My mom broke her leg yesterday, I am very worried.
Katya, and why are you eating nothing yourself today?
Thank you, I do not want any, maybe I will eat later.
How good that you and I went for an X-ray.
After all, I said right away that there might be a fracture.
If you really want to thank me for this.
I beg you very much, do not force Lyova to choose.

words.gloss: to force, to make (someone do something)
